capabilities: : Render vault notes as an interactive canvas
extras: AI is read-only; only chat notes and explicit links are written. Manual installation steps provided.
intentEvidence: An extended graph view for Obsidian where your notes open into AI chat boxes
problem: Users struggle to interact with the knowledge contained within their linked notes and graph structure in a dynamic way.

relations.evidence: Bonscape — the branching-conversations-on-a-canvas experience that inspired this plugin.
React Flow (xyflow) for the canvas engine.

summary: An extended graph view that allows users to chat with notes using a local AI CLI, saving conversations as linked markdown notes.
